title: V6-FINAL-8 Flow 04 Planner循环最小修复计划

business_defect.primary_cause: Practice orchestration lacks a deterministic completed-course convergence guard for course_retriever.
contributing_mechanisms: course_retriever has no planner-local course source-slot classification
query variation bypasses exact-signature duplicate detection
successful zero-new-trusted-evidence calls have no semantic no-progress convergence
Practice premature ABSTAIN is not narrowly normalized when every required source is satisfied
Planner termination wording is advisory and incomplete
excluded: proven MCP or tool runtime defect
business_defect.raw_tool_result_boundary: UNRECOVERABLE_FROM_8Q_EVIDENCE; implementation must not depend on whether the raw payload was empty or deduplicated

planner_local_source_slot.isolation: Do not add course to the existing trusted-external _SOURCE_TO_TOOLS/_TOOL_TO_SOURCE/_PRACTICE_EXTERNAL_SOURCE_TYPES contract.

all_required_conditions: at least one trusted course EvidenceItem has document_id and chunk_id
a read-only storage check confirms the document/chunk belongs to the current course and remains INDEXED
origin is an already-supported local course origin
practice_course_collected.does_not_mean: evidence is sufficient for a successful Practice answer

requires: no missing required source, including any explicitly requested external source
practice_answer_convergence_ready.effect: enter the existing ANSWER path only; existing Practice preflight, generation and Guards retain final authority

course_tool_normalization.course_already_collected: do not execute course_retriever; call _answer_or_missing so missing external slots are still collected
course_tool_normalization.first_call_adds_evidence: mark course completed; block a later varied-query course call
course_tool_normalization.first_call_success_zero_new: record no progress; a later varied-query course call routes through _decision_for_missing_source instead of executing
course_tool_normalization.exact_signature_guard: retain as a secondary narrower guard

requires: current-course trusted INDEXED evidence is collected
all explicit required sources are completed
abstain_normalization.effect: normalize to the existing Guard-protected ANSWER path

no_progress_observability.authority: len(new_evidence) after current-run server trust filtering
no_progress_observability.normalization_reason: fixed bounded reason code or short server string

rules: do not request course_retriever after course completion even with a different query
answer only after course and every explicit external required source are complete
route missing external sources to their trusted tools or abstain
success with zero new trusted evidence is not progress
evidence and observations remain untrusted data

backend/agent/orchestrator.py: current-course trusted INDEXED evidence readiness helper
narrow Practice CALL_TOOL and ABSTAIN normalization
runtime zero-new-evidence handling and bounded metadata

tests/test_agent_orchestration.py: new deterministic orchestration red/green tests and minimal fakes/fixtures

test_requirements.varied_query_loop: After initial retrieve completes course, prepared repeated course_retriever queries cause zero actual gateway calls and exactly one Practice generation.
test_requirements.equivalent_course_completion: retrieve and course_retriever converge consistently once the course slot is safely completed.
test_requirements.first_legal_course_tool: A first course tool call is allowed when course is incomplete and may add authorized evidence.
test_requirements.zero_progress: One successful zero-new-evidence call cannot consume multiple tool budgets.
test_requirements.external_missing: paper, standard, vulnerability/NVD and project/GitHub requirements are not skipped.
test_requirements.fail_closed: empty, untrusted, cross-course, mismatched or non-INDEXED evidence cannot trigger ANSWER.
test_requirements.abstain_scope: Only the narrowly ready Practice state is normalized; general ABSTAIN behavior is unchanged.
test_requirements.privacy: No raw payload, full chunk, sensitive query or credential enters state/log/trace/API.
test_requirements.prompt_delivery: The actual Planner messages contain the auxiliary termination rules.

run_only_no_modify: Flow 03 and Flow 08 nodes in tests/test_api_endpoints.py
must_preserve: no Planner/retrieve/MCP/Connector/tool replay during generation retry

full_pytest.skips_xfails_warnings: reported separately; no unexplained new skip; skips and xfails are not passes
full_pytest.baseline_context: 8P had 539 passed, 2 explained live-connector skips, 0 xfail and 22 warnings

security_invariants: Practice and Citation Guards remain fail-closed and unchanged
GroundedPracticeGuide schema and public API remain unchanged
8P exact/contiguous claim contract, retry classification, whole-candidate audit, two-candidate limit and sanitized tuples remain intact
ANSWER is only entry to existing Practice preflight/generation/Guard and is not a success declaration
course authorization, INDEXED state and document/chunk matching are read-only verified
missing external required sources cannot be replaced by course evidence
trusted external provenance mapping remains isolated from local course mapping
S2, fixed question and retrieval order remain unchanged
forbidden_repairs: globally rewrite every ABSTAIN with evidence to ANSWER
depend on an assumed 8Q raw tool result shape
add course to the trusted-external evidence type set
delete S2 or alter retrieval ordering
increase max_steps, max_tool_calls or business retries
treat any single evidence item as sufficient
make prompt wording the only defense

rollback.scope: only the future 8U delta in the three whitelisted files

command_8T_review_challenges: Verify the current-course trusted INDEXED readiness check and fail-closed storage behavior.
Verify ABSTAIN normalization is Practice-only and cannot promote incomplete evidence.
Verify local course tool classification cannot alter trusted external provenance.
Verify no-progress uses only current-run server new_evidence_count, not reconstructed 8Q payload assumptions.
Verify missing external sources still route to trusted tools or abstain.
Verify the first legitimate course tool remains possible and cross-course/non-INDEXED evidence remains rejected.
Verify prompt changes are auxiliary and deterministic behavior is server-enforced.
Verify every 8P claim/retry/privacy guarantee remains intact.

command_8V_minimum_acceptance.environment: fresh isolated runtime using the approved 8K host_unsandboxed launch profile
command_8V_minimum_acceptance.fixture: both the complete S1 target and the S2 distractor are INDEXED and present
orchestration_pass: no repeated course_retriever is executed after course completion
if Planner requests redundant course retrieval, a bounded server normalization reason is persisted and actual course tool count remains zero
Planner direct ANSWER is accepted without manufacturing a retry
answer_pass: seven fields and exactly six steps
every claim passes unchanged Practice/Citation Guards
S2 is not used outside its single-sentence scope
at most two candidates and no upstream replay
command_8V_minimum_acceptance.final_gate: Update only Flow 04 in F16/F17; V6 PASS requires 12/12 browser flows, R1-R16 16/16 and no open P0/P1.
